notes: VAT standard rate 24% since 1 Jul 2025 (EMTA rates page, updated 28 Jul 2025) - it rose 20% to 22% in Jan 2024 and to 24% in Jul 2025. Bullion EXEMPT: VAT Act s.16(2)(8) exempts investment gold (older English consolidation quoted for the exemption wording; the rate itself is from EMTA). Silver appears nowhere in s.16(2) (24/24). Import duty 0% (EU CN 2026: HS 7108 'Free').

sources.name: Estonian Tax and Customs Board (emta.ee) - Value added tax rates
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: from 1 July 2025 the standard rate of VAT is 24%
sources.quote: From 1 July 2025, the standard rate of VAT is 24%.

sources.name: Value-Added Tax Act (Riigi Teataja), s.16(2)(8)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: VAT is not imposed on the supply of investment gold or related transfer/agent services
sources.quote: Value added tax shall also not be imposed on the supply of the following goods and services: 8) investment gold, services relating to the transfer of investment gold or entry into a corresponding transfer agreement

sources.name: European Commission - Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1926, Combined Nomenclature 2026 (EUR-Lex)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28 (in the SI/LT pass): HS 7108 lines carry the conventional duty rate 'Free'
